Welcome back for the post-lunch session! Pakistan need just one more wicket to expose the Sri Lankan tail, while Sonal Dinusha and Kusal Mendis have a huge task ahead of them. Both will need to score big hundreds if Sri Lanka are to even think about making a comeback in this contest. Pakistan are also a seamer short, so the break would have given their three fast bowlers some much-needed rest. Alright, here we go again..
